name: ifc-atlas-desktop
description: IFC Atlas desktop app (Tauri v2 wrapper)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.verify:backend:tests: cd backend && python -m pytest -q -m "not requires_ifc_load and not subprocess_sandbox"
scripts.verify:backend:smoke: cd backend && python -c "from app.services.agent_registry import agent_registry; from app.services.ids_service import validate_ids; from app.services.mcp_registry import mcp_registry; print('ok')"
scripts.verify:backend: npm run verify:backend:tests && npm run verify:backend:smoke
scripts.verify:frontend: npm run verify:frontend:typecheck && npm run verify:frontend:tests && npm run verify:frontend:build
scripts.verify:docs: npm run verify:docs:generated && python -m mkdocs build --strict
scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend && npm run verify:sidecar && npm run verify:docs
